name: Light — Reflection and Refraction
summary: Reflection at curved mirrors, refraction through lenses, and the mirror/lens formulae.

steps.title: Reflection at spherical mirrors
steps.instruction: Define centre of curvature, focus, and the mirror formula 1/v + 1/u = 1/f.

steps.title: Refraction through lenses
steps.instruction: Trace rays through convex/concave lenses; apply the lens formula and magnification.

name: Electricity
summary: Ohm's law, resistance, series/parallel circuits, and heating effect of current.

steps.title: Ohm's law
steps.instruction: State V = IR and plot V–I to find resistance.

steps.title: Series and parallel
steps.instruction: Derive equivalent resistance for series and parallel combinations.
